let fail = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < cases.length; i++) {
  const a = JSON.stringify(processEvents(cases[i]));
  const b = JSON.stringify(orig(cases[i]));
  if (a !== b) { fail++; console.log("MISMATCH", i, JSON.stringify(cases[i]), a, b); }
}
console.log(fail === 0 ? "ALL PASS" : fail + " FAIL");
